startedBy.speaker: Sorine Jurard
startedBy.speakerNamed: alias SorineAlias of DLC1HunterBaseStage2 (Bolstering the Ranks) (unique)
startedBy.prompt: Where can I find him?
reply: Well, that's the thing. We don't know where he is. Haven't seen him in years.
I think he had regular contact with the Vigilants, and I know Isran kept track of them...
So maybe you could ask Isran if he knows anything? Just keep in mind that he... well, he might not like the idea.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is the one in alias SorineAlias

movedBy.speaker: Isran
movedBy.speakerNamed: alias IsranAlias of DLC1HunterBaseStage2 (Bolstering the Ranks) (unique)
movedBy.prompt: Sorine thought we'd need his help.
reply: I suppose she's right. I shouldn't let my personal feelings get in the way.
Last I'd heard of him, he was aiding the Vigilants of Stendarr at Ruunvald. He may still be there.
If he can maintain some appearance of normalcy, I'll allow him to stay.

movedBy.speakerNamed: alias TolanAlias of DLC1HunterBaseStage2 (Bolstering the Ranks) (unique)

If he's moved on, perhaps the Vigilants there can tell you where he's gone.

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
